lines.text: The King, he is hunting the deer; I am coursing myself. They have pitched a toil; I am toiling in a pitch, pitch that defiles. Defile! A foul word! Well, set thee down, sorrow, for so they say the fool said, and so say I, and I the fool. Well proved, wit! By the Lord, this love is as mad as Ajax. It kills sheep, it kills me, I a sheep. Well proved again, o' my side! I will not love; if I do, hang me! I' faith, I will not. O, but her eye! By this light, but for her eye, I would not love her; yes, for her two eyes. Well, I do nothing in the world but lie, and lie in my throat. By heaven, I do love, and it hath taught me to rhyme, and to be melancholy. And here is part of my rhyme, and here my melancholy. Well, she hath one o' my sonnets already. The clown bore it, the fool sent it, and the lady hath it. Sweet clown, sweeter fool, sweetest lady! By the world, I would not care a pin if the other three were in. Here comes one with a paper. God give him grace to groan!

lines.text: O, if in black my lady's brows be decked,
lines.plainText: O if in black my lady's brows be decked

lines.text: It mourns that painting and usurping hair
lines.plainText: It mourns that painting and usurping hair

lines.text: Should ravish doters with a false aspect;
lines.plainText: Should ravish doters with a false aspect

lines.text: And therefore is she born to make black fair.
lines.plainText: And therefore is she born to make black fair

lines.text: Her favour turns the fashion of the days,
lines.plainText: Her favour turns the fashion of the days

lines.text: For native blood is counted painting now;
lines.plainText: For native blood is counted painting now

lines.text: And therefore red, that would avoid dispraise,
lines.plainText: And therefore red that would avoid dispraise

lines.text: Paints itself black, to imitate her brow.
lines.plainText: Paints itself black to imitate her brow

lines.text: To look like her are chimney-sweepers black.
lines.plainText: To look like her are chimneysweepers black

lines.text: And since her time are colliers counted bright.
lines.plainText: And since her time are colliers counted bright

lines.text: And Ethiopes of their sweet complexion crack.
lines.plainText: And Ethiopes of their sweet complexion crack

lines.text: Dark needs no candles now, for dark is light.
lines.plainText: Dark needs no candles now for dark is light

lines.text: Your mistresses dare never come in rain,
lines.plainText: Your mistresses dare never come in rain

lines.text: For fear their colours should be washed away.
lines.plainText: For fear their colours should be washed away

lines.text: 'Twere good yours did; for, sir, to tell you plain,
lines.plainText: 'Twere good yours did for sir to tell you plain

lines.text: I'll find a fairer face not washed today.
lines.plainText: I'll find a fairer face not washed today

lines.text: I'll prove her fair, or talk till doomsday here.
lines.plainText: I'll prove her fair or talk till doomsday here

lines.text: No devil will fright thee then so much as she.
lines.plainText: No devil will fright thee then so much as she

lines.text: I never knew man hold vile stuff so dear.
lines.plainText: I never knew man hold vile stuff so dear

lines.text: [Showing his shoe.]
lines.plainText: Showing his shoe

lines.text: Look, here's thy love, my foot and her face see.
lines.plainText: Look here's thy love my foot and her face see

lines.text: O, if the streets were paved with thine eyes,
lines.plainText: O if the streets were paved with thine eyes

lines.text: Her feet were much too dainty for such tread.
lines.plainText: Her feet were much too dainty for such tread

lines.text: O vile! Then, as she goes, what upward lies
lines.plainText: O vile Then as she goes what upward lies

lines.text: The street should see as she walked over head.
lines.plainText: The street should see as she walked over head

lines.text: But what of this? Are we not all in love?
lines.plainText: But what of this Are we not all in love

lines.text: Nothing so sure, and thereby all forsworn.
lines.plainText: Nothing so sure and thereby all forsworn

lines.text: Then leave this chat, and, good Berowne, now prove
lines.plainText: Then leave this chat and good Berowne now prove

lines.text: Our loving lawful, and our faith not torn.
lines.plainText: Our loving lawful and our faith not torn

lines.text: Ay, marry, there; some flattery for this evil.
lines.plainText: Ay marry there some flattery for this evil

lines.text: O, some authority how to proceed.
lines.plainText: O some authority how to proceed

lines.text: Some tricks, some quillets, how to cheat the devil.
lines.plainText: Some tricks some quillets how to cheat the devil

lines.text: Some salve for perjury.
lines.plainText: Some salve for perjury

lines.text: O, 'tis more than need.
lines.plainText: O 'tis more than need

lines.text: Have at you, then, affection's men-at-arms.
lines.plainText: Have at you then affection's menatarms

lines.text: Consider what you first did swear unto:
lines.plainText: Consider what you first did swear unto

lines.text: To fast, to study, and to see no woman—
lines.plainText: To fast to study and to see no woman

lines.text: Flat treason 'gainst the kingly state of youth.
lines.plainText: Flat treason 'gainst the kingly state of youth

lines.text: Say, can you fast? Your stomachs are too young,
lines.plainText: Say can you fast Your stomachs are too young

lines.text: And abstinence engenders maladies.
lines.plainText: And abstinence engenders maladies

lines.text: O, we have made a vow to study, lords,
lines.plainText: O we have made a vow to study lords

lines.text: And in that vow we have forsworn our books;
lines.plainText: And in that vow we have forsworn our books

lines.text: For when would you, my liege, or you, or you,
lines.plainText: For when would you my liege or you or you

lines.text: In leaden contemplation have found out
lines.plainText: In leaden contemplation have found out

lines.text: Such fiery numbers as the prompting eyes
lines.plainText: Such fiery numbers as the prompting eyes

lines.text: Of beauty's tutors have enriched you with?
lines.plainText: Of beauty's tutors have enriched you with

lines.text: Other slow arts entirely keep the brain,
lines.plainText: Other slow arts entirely keep the brain

lines.text: And therefore, finding barren practisers,
lines.plainText: And therefore finding barren practisers

lines.text: Scarce show a harvest of their heavy toil;
lines.plainText: Scarce show a harvest of their heavy toil

lines.text: But love, first learned in a lady's eyes,
lines.plainText: But love first learned in a lady's eyes

lines.text: Lives not alone immured in the brain,
lines.plainText: Lives not alone immured in the brain

lines.text: But with the motion of all elements
lines.plainText: But with the motion of all elements

lines.text: Courses as swift as thought in every power,
lines.plainText: Courses as swift as thought in every power

lines.text: And gives to every power a double power,
lines.plainText: And gives to every power a double power

lines.text: Above their functions and their offices.
lines.plainText: Above their functions and their offices

lines.text: It adds a precious seeing to the eye.
lines.plainText: It adds a precious seeing to the eye

lines.text: A lover's eyes will gaze an eagle blind.
lines.plainText: A lover's eyes will gaze an eagle blind

lines.text: A lover's ear will hear the lowest sound,
lines.plainText: A lover's ear will hear the lowest sound

lines.text: When the suspicious head of theft is stopped.
lines.plainText: When the suspicious head of theft is stopped

lines.text: Love's feeling is more soft and sensible
lines.plainText: Love's feeling is more soft and sensible

lines.text: Than are the tender horns of cockled snails.
lines.plainText: Than are the tender horns of cockled snails

lines.text: Love's tongue proves dainty Bacchus gross in taste.
lines.plainText: Love's tongue proves dainty Bacchus gross in taste

lines.text: For valour, is not Love a Hercules,
lines.plainText: For valour is not Love a Hercules

lines.text: Still climbing trees in the Hesperides?
lines.plainText: Still climbing trees in the Hesperides

lines.text: Subtle as Sphinx, as sweet and musical
lines.plainText: Subtle as Sphinx as sweet and musical

lines.text: As bright Apollo's lute, strung with his hair.
lines.plainText: As bright Apollo's lute strung with his hair

lines.text: And when Love speaks, the voice of all the gods
lines.plainText: And when Love speaks the voice of all the gods

lines.text: Make heaven drowsy with the harmony.
lines.plainText: Make heaven drowsy with the harmony

lines.text: Never durst poet touch a pen to write
lines.plainText: Never durst poet touch a pen to write

lines.text: Until his ink were tempered with Love's sighs.
lines.plainText: Until his ink were tempered with Love's sighs

lines.text: O, then his lines would ravish savage ears
lines.plainText: O then his lines would ravish savage ears

lines.text: And plant in tyrants mild humility.
lines.plainText: And plant in tyrants mild humility

lines.text: From women's eyes this doctrine I derive.
lines.plainText: From women's eyes this doctrine I derive

lines.text: They sparkle still the right Promethean fire;
lines.plainText: They sparkle still the right Promethean fire

lines.text: They are the books, the arts, the academes,
lines.plainText: They are the books the arts the academes

lines.text: That show, contain, and nourish, all the world;
lines.plainText: That show contain and nourish all the world

lines.text: Else none at all in aught proves excellent.
lines.plainText: Else none at all in aught proves excellent

lines.text: Then fools you were these women to forswear,
lines.plainText: Then fools you were these women to forswear

lines.text: Or, keeping what is sworn, you will prove fools.
lines.plainText: Or keeping what is sworn you will prove fools

lines.text: For wisdom's sake, a word that all men love,
lines.plainText: For wisdom's sake a word that all men love

lines.text: Or for love's sake, a word that loves all men,
lines.plainText: Or for love's sake a word that loves all men

lines.text: Or for men's sake, the authors of these women,
lines.plainText: Or for men's sake the authors of these women

lines.text: Or women's sake, by whom we men are men,
lines.plainText: Or women's sake by whom we men are men

lines.text: Let us once lose our oaths to find ourselves,
lines.plainText: Let us once lose our oaths to find ourselves

lines.text: Or else we lose ourselves to keep our oaths.
lines.plainText: Or else we lose ourselves to keep our oaths

lines.text: It is religion to be thus forsworn,
lines.plainText: It is religion to be thus forsworn

lines.text: For charity itself fulfils the law,
lines.plainText: For charity itself fulfils the law

lines.text: And who can sever love from charity?
lines.plainText: And who can sever love from charity

lines.text: Saint Cupid, then, and, soldiers, to the field!
lines.plainText: Saint Cupid then and soldiers to the field

lines.plainText: Advance your standards and upon them lords

lines.text: Pell-mell, down with them! But be first advised
lines.plainText: Pellmell down with them But be first advised

lines.text: In conflict that you get the sun of them.
lines.plainText: In conflict that you get the sun of them

lines.text: Now to plain dealing. Lay these glozes by.
lines.plainText: Now to plain dealing Lay these glozes by

lines.text: Shall we resolve to woo these girls of France?
lines.plainText: Shall we resolve to woo these girls of France

lines.text: And win them too. Therefore let us devise
lines.plainText: And win them too Therefore let us devise

lines.text: Some entertainment for them in their tents.
lines.plainText: Some entertainment for them in their tents

lines.text: First, from the park let us conduct them thither.
lines.plainText: First from the park let us conduct them thither

lines.text: Then homeward every man attach the hand
lines.plainText: Then homeward every man attach the hand

lines.text: Of his fair mistress. In the afternoon
lines.plainText: Of his fair mistress In the afternoon

lines.text: We will with some strange pastime solace them,
lines.plainText: We will with some strange pastime solace them

lines.text: Such as the shortness of the time can shape;
lines.plainText: Such as the shortness of the time can shape

lines.text: For revels, dances, masques, and merry hours
lines.plainText: For revels dances masques and merry hours

lines.plainText: Forerun fair Love strewing her way with flowers

lines.plainText: Away away No time shall be omitted

lines.text: That will betime and may by us be fitted.
lines.plainText: That will betime and may by us be fitted

lines.text: Allons! allons! Sowed cockle reaped no corn,
lines.plainText: Allons allons Sowed cockle reaped no corn

lines.text: And justice always whirls in equal measure.
lines.plainText: And justice always whirls in equal measure

lines.plainText: Light wenches may prove plagues to men forsworn
